first_spiral_findings.finding: Model-produced independent_confirmation can be treated as independent evidence and may allow fact_allowed=true without external validation.
Duplicate or normalization-colliding request_id values can overwrite receipts and silently lose one request.
Processor writes under sanitized ID while verification can read raw ID, causing persistent requeue/failure.
One malformed queued request can abort the batch and repeatedly block valid work.
Sensitive receipt is created before chmod 0600; shared-directory exposure window exists and chmod failure is swallowed.
Bare dnsmasq matching can classify ordinary DNS queries as DHCP, distorting telemetry histograms.
Substring 'drop' can classify Dropbear AUTH events as FIREWALL.
Capture duration uses wall clock instead of monotonic time, weakening bounded-duration semantics under clock steps.
Workflow passes hard-coded owner identity instead of actual triggering actor to authorization verifier.
Authenticated-owner gate can succeed independently of real workflow initiator because actor identity is hard-coded.
Remote Scout/Terminal channel imports aiohttp without repository-declared dependency, breaking clean-checkout reproducibility.

first_spiral_findings.event: Classic PAT JANUS_HABITAT_GATE_QNAP created with broad scopes including admin:enterprise, repo, workflow, user, audit_log and other write scopes.
GitGuardian reported secret findings in PRs 67, 68, 69 and 71; PR71 incident 36138308 was Triggered as Generic High Entropy Secret in JSON and Python occurrences.
Third-party OAuth app Tranceptor Technology authorized with read:org and user:email on 2026-06-12.

cross_layer_invariant.statement: DATA MAY TRANSFORM; PROVENANCE MUST NOT BE SYNTHESIZED.
